shared_elements: raised bent arm holding an object
low-relief figures arranged along a wall surface
quadruped animals in profile (A only pairs, B none)
justification: Both depict profile standing figures in long patterned, fringed robes carved in low relief with one arm bent and raised holding something, and both include rosette-like floral motifs, which is a moderately specific shared convention. However, A shows a whole architectural ruin with columns, stairways, a repeating file of small procession figures and a lion-attacking-bull group, while B shows a single large bird-headed winged figure beside a stylized plant — the dominant motifs and compositions are quite different.
